channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Suplício de usuários de trens encolhe circo privatista de SP
item.description: The article criticizes the privatization of public transportation services in São Paulo, arguing that selling essential services to private companies has worsened the quality of transit for users rather than improving it. Using the metaphor of a circus, it suggests that, contrary to what Governor Tarcísio de Freitas aims to demonstrate, privatization does not expand services but shrinks them, making them more precarious and burdensome for the population.

item.title: Zema promete acabar com sigilos e ampliar transparência no governo
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party’s presidential candidate, pledged to end government secrecy and increase transparency in public administration, stating he will make his expenses and official commitments public and demand the same from all public officials. He criticized the federal government’s overuse of secrecy and positioned himself as a defender of accountability and access to information.

item.title: Zema promete não aumentar impostos e cortar gastos públicos
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's presidential candidate, promised not to raise taxes and to cut public spending if elected. He emphasized that his administration will prioritize fiscal balance without resorting to new taxes. The statement was made during a sabatina by O Antagonista and G4, the first in a series of interviews.

item.title: Vou defender que “tudo seja investigado, doa a quem doer”, afirma Zema
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's pre-candidate for President of Brazil, stated in a sabatina with O Antagonista and G4 that he has 'nothing to hide' and will defend that all investigations be carried out, regardless of who is affected, in a potential government. The remark was made during the first major event of his 2026 presidential campaign.

item.title: Ex-assessor de Lula diz que dinheiro recebido de amiga de Lulinha foi empréstimo
item.description: Former Chief of Staff to President Lula, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola), admitted receiving money from Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Lulinha under PF investigation, but claimed it was a personal loan already repaid and denied any illegality. The transaction, reported by Poder360, occurred during his tenure and raises suspicions of influence peddling tied to the 'Careca do INSS' scandal.

item.title: TSE manda governo remover publicações com destaque pessoal a Lula em canais oficiais
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, ordered the federal government to remove posts on official channels that promote the personal actions of President Lula, a reelection candidate, during the electoral period. The decision aims to prevent institutional content from becoming prohibited personal campaigning under electoral law, also requiring platforms like Facebook and X to remove such posts within 24 hours.

item.title: “Sou totalmente contrário ao toma lá, dá cá, diz Zema
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's pre-candidate for president of Brazil, stated he is totally opposed to 'quid pro quo' politics — the exchange of favors between the Executive and Legislative branches — during a sabatina hosted by O Antagonista and G4. This marks the first major event of his presidential campaign, underscoring his stance against corruption and political patronage in Brazil.

item.title: Lula é aprovado por 52% e desaprovado por 47% no Pará, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey by Real Time Big Data conducted between July 30 and August 3, 2026, in Pará shows that 52% of voters approve of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s government, while 47% disapprove. Regarding performance evaluation, 42% rated the government as excellent or good, 22% as regular, and 35% as bad or terrible. The poll interviewed 1,600 people aged 16 or older, with a 2-percentage-point margin of error and registration at the TSE under code BR-09650/2026.

item.title: PL já tem nome escalado para substituir Canella na disputa ao Senado no Rio
item.description: Deputy Carlos Jordy (PL) is expected to be launched as the Senate candidate for Rio de Janeiro following the withdrawal of Márcio Canella (União Brasil), who opted to run for the state Legislative Assembly. Canella announced his withdrawal in a social media video, citing his recent arrest for illegal firearm possession and the distancing of the União-PP federation from Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign. The PL aims to have two Senate candidates in the state, as Carlos Portinho already holds one seat.

item.title: Lula tem 45% contra 36% de Flávio no 2º turno no Pará, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Real Time Big Data poll shows President Lula leading with 45% against Flávio Bolsonaro's 36% in a potential runoff in Pará. In the first round, the incumbent also holds a lead with 43% of voting intentions compared to 33% for the senator.

item.title: Ídolo do São Paulo, Luis Fabiano se declara assexual em candidatura
item.description: Luis Fabiano, former São Paulo striker and MDB pre-candidate for federal deputy in 2026, had his sexual orientation mistakenly recorded as 'asexual' in the electoral registry, according to the party, which said it will correct the error. He announced his candidacy in May, emphasizing his goal to transform the future of youth and Brazilian cities, and declared assets worth R$20 million and 27 properties.

item.title: Sem paz e amor, Lula promete gestão porreta e mira vitória no 1º turno
item.description: Lula confirmed his 2026 re-election bid under the PT, stating he has definitively moved past the "Lulinha paz e amor" image to adopt a firmer, more confrontational stance. He promised a "porreta" fourth term marked by bold decisions and willingness to challenge the opposition, aiming to win in the first round. Noblat’s analysis underscores Lula’s determination to conclude his presidential trajectory with a decisive victory.

item.title: PT aciona Nikolas Ferreira na Justiça por propaganda antecipada negativa contra Lula
item.description: Federal Deputy Rogério Correia (PT-MG) filed a formal complaint with the General Prosecutor's Office (PGR) against Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) for negative anticipatory electoral propaganda against President Lula. The move comes ahead of the 2026 elections, with the PT alleging that Ferreira disseminated harmful content before the legally permitted campaign period.

item.title: Lula soube há duas semanas do empréstimo de lobista de Careca do INSS a seu assessor
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva learned two weeks ago about a loan obtained by Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as 'Marcola', his former chief of staff, from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger of the INSS. According to sources close to the president, Lula felt 'sad' and 'disappointed' by the revelation. The exclusive report highlights a potential conflict of interest involving a senior aide.

item.title: Visitas a Lula em Curitiba, controle da agenda e empréstimo na mira da PF: saiba quem é Marcola, ex-chefe de gabinete do presidente
item.description: Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola, served as Chief of Staff to President Lula until July 2024 and maintained direct access to the president for years, including during Lula’s imprisonment in Curitiba. He received a loan from Roberta Luchsinger, a businesswoman under investigation by the Federal Police for alleged participation in INSS fraud schemes and a friend of the president’s son, Lulinha. His move from chief of staff to the campaign team has raised concerns about potential conflicts of interest and influence over the presidential agenda.

item.title: Lula indica Antônio Carlos Berwanger para diretoria da CVM
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has nominated Antônio Carlos Berwanger for a director position at the Brazilian Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM), with the formal submission to the Senate published in the Official Gazette on August 4, 2026. Berwanger, who has led the CVM’s Market Development Superintendency since 2015, brings extensive experience in capital markets regulation, including oversight of the regulatory sandbox and the Experimentation Laboratory. He holds degrees in Economics and Law, a master’s in Regulatory Law from FGV, and a specialization in Fintechs and Regulatory Innovation from the University of Cambridge.

item.title: Ex-chefe de gabinete de Lula admite ter recebido empréstimo de amiga de Lulinha investigada pela PF
item.description: Former chief of staff to President Lula, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, admitted receiving a personal loan from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, who is under investigation by the Federal Police for suspected influence peddling involving Lula’s eldest son, Lulinha. Ribeiro stated the loan was personal and already repaid, but the PF cites the transaction in requests to open inquiries into whether it constituted a bribe to gain access to government offices, including the Ministry of Health and the Presidential Palace. Luchsinger allegedly made over 40 unregistered visits to federal agencies between 2023 and 2025, often accompanied by businessman Antônio Camilo Antunes (‘Careca do INSS’), with suspected backing from Lulinha.

item.title: Universalizar escola em tempo integral custaria R$ 170 bilhões e desafia espaço fiscal de Lula
item.description: Universalizing full-time schooling in Brazil would cost R$ 170 billion over 10 years, according to a proposal under discussion for Lula’s government program. The figure poses a significant challenge to the administration’s fiscal space, requiring budget adjustments or new revenue sources. While educationally beneficial, the measure strains public finances amid a context of spending restraint.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e aliados usam empréstimo de empresária alvo no caso INSS a ex-assessor de Lula para desgastar presidente
item.description: Opposition lawmakers, led by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), criticized the Lula government after reports revealed that former Chief of the Personal Presidency Office, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola), received a personal loan from businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger, who is under PF investigation linked to the 'INSS Careca' scheme. The opposition claims the loan indicates the infiltration of alleged INSS fraud into the presidential office, though Marcola stated the loan was personal, already repaid, and unrelated to his official duties.

item.title: Dinheiro para auxiliar de Lula eleva radiatividade de Lulinha
item.description: The Lulinha case, involving President Lula's son, gained prominence after the discovery of a financial link between his friend Roberta Luchsinger, an INSS lobbyist, and Marco Aurélio Ribeiro, a Lula aide known as Marcola. Suspicions arise that this relationship was used to facilitate government contracts, raising concerns about influence peddling and corruption.

item.title: Investigações das fraudes do INSS causam estragos em personagens próximos a Lula e Flávio
item.description: Investigations into INSS fraud are causing political damage to figures close to Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, affecting indistinctly the leading presidential candidates in 2026. The scandal, revealed in an exclusive subscriber-only report, exposes a climate of instability that could undermine support bases on both ends of the political spectrum.

item.title: Farra do INSS: advogado alvo da PF é “amigo” de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Police launched a new phase of Operation Sem Desconto, investigating the so-called 'INSS Party', executing 18 search and seizure warrants authorized by the STF. Among the targets is lawyer Willer Tomaz, a personal friend of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), whom Bolsonaro publicly called 'my friend' during the 2021 Senate Covid CPI and traveled with to Florida in 2025 aboard a jet owned by the proprietors of União Química laboratory. Relatives of Senator Weverton Rocha (PDT-MA) are also targeted.

item.title: Nikolas lamenta desistência de Cleitinho: "PL apostava as fichas nele"
item.description: Nikolas Ferreira regretted Cleitinho Azevedo's withdrawal from the Minas Gerais gubernatorial race, stating that the Liberal Party had placed its hopes on his candidacy. He acknowledged Cleitinho's reasons tied to mourning his brother's death and said the PL will decide by Wednesday (August 5) its electoral path, awaiting national leadership guidance from figures like Flávio Bolsonaro and Marinho.

item.title: Senador Weverton Rocha é alvo de operação da PF que apura fraudes no INSS
item.description: Senator Weverton Rocha (PDT-MA) is a target of a Federal Police operation investigating suspected money laundering within Operation Sem Desconto, which probes improper discounts against INSS retirees and pensioners. The operation executes 18 search and seizure warrants in the Federal District and Maranhão, also targeting lawyer Willer Tomaz, close to Flávio Bolsonaro, and other politicians. The PF has concluded one inquiry related to Conafer, indicting former INSS presidents and others for corruption, criminal organization, and pension fraud.

item.title: Megaoperação mira grupo que planejava atentado em Brasília nas eleições
item.description: The Civil Police of the Federal District launched Operation Rede Interrompida to enforce precautionary measures against eight suspects accused of planning attacks in Brasília during the 2026 elections. The targets, aged 19 to 31, are located in five Brazilian states and were investigated by the DPCev following a technical report from Ciberlab. Authorities found evidence of discussions on building invasions, target selection, tactical training, sharing of architectural plans and explosives manuals, though the case has not yet been classified under the Terrorism Law.

item.title: Atentado em Brasília: grupo tinha plantas de prédios e manuais de explosivos
item.description: A group investigated in Operation Rede Interrompida, launched by the Federal District Civil Police, was sharing architectural plans, 3D models of buildings in Brasília, and explosives manufacturing manuals while discussing potential actions during the 2026 election period. The operation, involving police from five states and support from Ciberlab, carried out diligences against eight suspects aged 19 to 31, investigated for criminal association, incitement to crime, and apologia of crime, though not yet charged under the Terrorism Law.

item.title: Lula envia ao Senado nome de novo diretor da CVM
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva submitted to the Federal Senate the nomination of Antonio Carlos Berwanguer to fill the vacancy left at the CVM (Securities and Exchange Commission) following the end of Otto Lobo's term, who currently presides over the agency. The announcement was published as exclusive content for subscribers, with full access requiring registration on the publication's website.

item.title: Saiba quais pesquisas eleitorais podem sair nesta 3ª feira
item.description: Electoral polls registered with the TSE are cleared for publication starting this Tuesday, August 4, 2026, covering six Brazilian states. The release complies with electoral transparency laws. Poder360 offers subscribers access to its Poll Aggregator, the oldest and most comprehensive in Brazil, containing validated surveys since 2000.

item.title: Agenda de Lula: leia os compromissos do presidente nesta 3ª feira
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has a schedule in Brasília this Tuesday, starting with a meeting at the Palácio do Alvorada at 10 a.m. with Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira. In the afternoon at the Palácio do Planalto, he meets with Marcelo Weick (Civil House) at 3 p.m., Sandra Brandão (Personal Office) at 4 p.m., and signs Bill 3.085/2026, which establishes a 'relevance filter' for appeals at the Superior Court of Justice, at 5:30 p.m.

item.title: Apoio do Republicanos faria Flávio superar Lula no tempo de TV
item.description: The potential support of the Republicanos party for Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential bid would grant him more free electoral airtime on TV and radio than President Lula, according to his allies. Lula is expected to run with a coalition of seven parties, while Flávio currently has only the PL. The Republicanos leadership has conditioned its support on naming Damares Alves as his running mate.

item.title: Isolamento político ameaça empurrar chapa de Flávio Bolsonaro para um vice radical do PL
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign (PL) is struggling to find a running mate after rejections from Republicans, PP, and likely neutrality from Podemos, pushing the party toward a purely bolsonarist ticket. Options now include radical figures like Julia Zanatta, Bia Kicis, or Rogério Marinho, with a preference for a woman to access electoral funds and appeal to female voters. Meanwhile, the campaign faces operational challenges in communications following a recent marketing leadership change and difficulty hiring production staff as the August campaign launch approaches.

item.title: Em decisão sigilosa, Kassio dá 24 horas para Presidência tirar do ar postagens que exaltam Lula
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques issued a sealed order giving the Presidency’s Secretariat of Social Communication (Secom) 24 hours to remove official government posts praising Lula’s reelection bid, and to refrain from publishing similar content until the end of the elections. The decision aims to prevent misuse of state resources for electoral campaigning.

item.title: Ministro da Justiça despacha pedido de Lulinha para apurar vazamentos
item.description: Justice Minister Wellington César Lima e Silva forwarded the request from Fábio Luís Lula da Silva's (Lulinha) defense to investigate an alleged leak of data from the Farra do INSS inquiry. The request was formally submitted on Monday (August 3) and sent to the General Corregidor of the Federal Police. The move aims to prompt the minister to take a stance on the ongoing dispute between the PF and the STF, following direct appeals by Lulinha's defense to the PF Corregedor, spurred by claims that Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign holds audio recordings of Lulinha with Roberta Luchsinger, also under investigation in the same case.

item.title: Governo prevê reverter parte do veto da UE à carne brasileira
item.description: The Brazilian government is seeking to reverse part of the European Union's ban on animal-origin product exports, set to take effect on September 3. Despite denying the EU's claims about inadequate antimicrobial use, Brazil faces challenges in proving full traceability of the bovine lifecycle — a key requirement for lifting the restrictions. Ongoing negotiations aim to meet EU health standards to avoid a blockade on beef, poultry, fish and other products.

item.title: Centrão trava alianças de Flávio, que aposta em base bolsonarista
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) struggles to form alliances with key Centrão parties (Republicans, Podemos, and União Progressista) and admits he may run the 2026 presidential race with only PL support. His campaign cites a BTG/Nexus poll showing his proximity to Lula in the first round as evidence of competitiveness, but Centrão parties remain reluctant, signaling neutrality and leaving decisions to state directories. Without broader coalition backing, Flávio would receive less broadcast time than Lula (4min18s vs 5min34s per block), weakening his campaign infrastructure.

item.title: Os sem-sem
item.description: The 2026 presidential election is seen not as a chance for renewal and hope of economic and social recovery, but as a mere obstacle to overcome to reach 2030, when real change may occur. Voters are motivated more by preventing the continuation of Lula or Bolsonaro than by belief in an immediate better future, reflecting the hollowing out of the vice-presidential role and the lack of solid party agreements.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: cenário é acirrado nos maiores colégios a 2 meses da eleição
item.description: Two months before the 2026 Brazilian presidential election, Lula leads in eight states, showing strong dominance in the Northeast, while the race is tight in São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro — which together account for 63.3 million voters. Flávio Bolsonaro leads in two states (including Acre), and six states show technical ties. The outlook remains uncertain in the largest electoral colleges, with a potential runoff likely in several regions.

item.title: Clima de "já ganhou" faz campanha de Tarcísio projetar menos doações
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas' (Republicanos) re-election campaign projects lower fundraising from individuals in 2026 compared to 2022, due to a 'already won' climate among business leaders driven by favorable polls and strong approval ratings. In 2022, he raised about R$19 million in private donations, far above his rivals, including a R$2 million contribution from Fabiano Zettel, later arrested in the Master scandal. Business engagement was aided by allies from Paulo Guedes’ economic team and fear of a PT victory, but current comfort may reduce donor mobilization.

item.title: PT, PSDB e PDT encerram maratona de convenções no DF
item.description: Party conventions in the Federal District conclude this Wednesday (August 5), highlighting the PSDB's nomination of Paula Belmonte for Governor; the PDT's confirmation of Senator Leila do Vôlei's re-election bid; and the Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PV, PCdoB) officially launching Leandro Grass as gubernatorial candidate and Erika Kokay for Senate, with ongoing negotiations to define the vice-presidential candidate on Grass's ticket. The deadline for candidate registration is August 15, and electoral campaigning will be permitted starting August 16.

item.title: Dez anos da Rio-2016: estudo aponta aumento do interesse dos brasileiros no esporte olímpico
item.description: Ten years after the Rio 2016 Olympics, an Ibope Repucom study for O GLOBO reveals that 85% of Brazil's internet-connected population (109 million people) has some level of interest in Olympic sports, a 168% increase since 2013. This represents 68 million new interested individuals, driven both by the growth in internet users (from 54 million to 128.8 million) and a nine-point rise in the proportion of interested people. The study also shows that 68% of fans are willing to try products from sponsors of athletes they admire, and 81% view sponsorship as essential for sports success.

item.title: Benefícios rejeitados pelo INSS aumentam 70%, e fila de pedidos cai pela metade
item.description: The Lula government increased denials of INSS benefits by 70% between January and May 2026, reaching 668,6 thousand monthly rejections — the highest level since 2021. This move helped halve the backlog of pending applications amid fiscal adjustment during the electoral period.

item.title: Barroso é internado após sofrer intoxicação alimentar na França
item.description: Former Supreme Court President Luís Roberto Barroso was hospitalized in São Paulo after suffering food poisoning from bacteria during a trip to Paris, leading to dehydration and temporary kidney impairment. He is under the care of Dr. Ludhmila Hajjar, responding well to treatment, and is expected to be discharged in the coming days. Despite his October 2025 retirement, his seat on the STF remains vacant, as Lula’s nomination of Jorge Messias was rejected by the Senate.

item.title: Urna eletrônica é patrimônio da democracia no Brasil, diz Nunes Marques
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques defended electronic voting machines as a cornerstone of Brazilian democracy during the reopening of Electoral Justice works in August 2026. He emphasized priorities including transparency, accessibility, auditability, and cybersecurity partnerships, proposing a dual-verification system involving voters and party poll workers. The defense responds to unsubstantiated fraud claims by figures such as Jair and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: MPSP apontou "subcontratação de 100% dos serviços" em esquema de BRT
item.description: The São Paulo Public Prosecutor's Office (MPSP) identified 100% subcontracting of services in a BRT project in São José dos Campos that was never implemented, involving a R$14.5 million embezzlement between 2014 and 2015. Former mayor Carlinhos Almeida and 14 others were convicted by the TJSP for administrative improbity, with evidence of duplicate contracts, favoritism toward public officials, and ties to Petistas, including a social scientist linked to a Lula-government solidarity economy project. The case indicates intentional administrative disorganization to divert public funds.

item.title: PM mata uma pessoa a cada 13 horas em SP, mostram dados da SSP
item.description: The Military Police of São Paulo caused 339 deaths in the first half of 2026, averaging nearly one every 13 hours, according to SSP data. Although this represents a slight decrease from 349 deaths in the same period of 2025, it remains significantly higher than the 201 killings recorded in 2023, the first year of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas’s administration. While violent crimes fell by 38% and arrests rose from 81,044 to 96,208, the state prison system faces a deficit of 85,226 vacancies — 156% above capacity.

item.title: Assessor de Lula confirma empréstimo de lobista, mas não revela valor
item.description: Former Chief of Staff to President Lula, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola), confirmed receiving a personal loan from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, already repaid, but did not disclose the amount. Roberta is under investigation for Social Security fraud and has ties to the imprisoned Careca do INSS. The disclosure has raised concerns within the PT, as corruption allegations could harm Lula’s 2026 re-election campaign.

item.title: A explicação do assessor de Lula para o dinheiro recebido de amiga de Lulinha
item.description: Lula's campaign advisor, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola), admitted receiving a personal loan from Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Lulinha under PF investigation for alleged lobbying on behalf of businessman Antônio Carlos Camilo. Marcola stated the loan was repaid and involved no illegality in his official duties, without disclosing amount or proof. The case is tied to PF investigations into Lulinha's business connections during Lula's government.

item.title: Renan Santos diz que Lula não vai a debates por causa de escândalos
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate of the Mission Party, claims President Lula avoids electoral debates due to alleged scandals involving payments from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger to Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola), former Chief of Staff at the Planalto. Santos argues these payments, linked to a Federal Police investigation into Social Security fraud, are one of thousands of reasons Lula refuses to debate, accusing the president of evading substantive issues and focusing only on propaganda.

item.title: Multiplicação de inquéritos contra Lulinha dificulta investigações e desafia doutrina do STF
item.description: Lulinha, son of President Lula, is facing multiple inquiries at the STF over alleged influence peddling, with rapporteurship split between Justices André Mendonça and Flávio Dino due to random case allocation. The PF opened separate procedures to investigate the same lobbying scheme, contrary to the STF’s doctrine of consolidating related investigations against the same individual for the same offense, which may fragment the probe and benefit the accused. This procedural division complicates clarification by creating different rapporteurs, teams, and priorities.

item.title: Presidente do Republicanos diz a Flávio Bolsonaro que maioria do partido apoia neutralidade na eleição presidencial
item.description: The president of the Republicans party, Marcos Pereira, told Flávio Bolsonaro that 17 of the party’s 27 state directories support neutrality in the presidential election, while nine back the PL pre-candidate and one supports Lula’s re-election. The meeting took place in Brasília with Rogerio Marinho and Valdemar Costa Neto. Despite seeking an alliance, the Republicans are expected to confirm neutrality at their national convention on Tuesday (4), while the PL still lacks coalition partners and has registered Flávio Bolsonaro without a running mate.
